title: White sauce
hook: Milk, butter, flour. *Change the dose*, change the sauce.

dishes.name: Cream soup
dishes.text: Just 4 g each of butter and flour. Starch swells *just enough* for a silky soup.

dishes.name: Béchamel
dishes.text: *6 g each*: the classic sauce for lasagna, gratins and mac and cheese.

dishes.name: Soufflé base
dishes.text: *9 g each*: thick enough to bind croquettes and hold up a soufflé.

sheet_text: More butter and flour, *a thicker sauce*.
sources: https://app.ckbk.com/section/prof36725c08s001ss002sss002ssss005/proportions-of-roux-to-liquid (Gisslen, Professional Cooking: per 4 L liquid, thin 190 g / medium 250 g / thick 375 g each butter and flour, roux equal parts by weight ≈ 4.6 / 6.1 / 9.1 per 100 g)
https://www.cooksinfo.com/white-sauce (thin / medium / thick = 1 / 2 / 3 Tbsp each butter and flour per cup milk ≈ 3.3 / 6.7 / 10 g flour per 100 g)
https://tasteoffrancemag.com/recipes/michel-rouxs-ultimate-bechamel-recipe (classic béchamel 60 g butter, 60 g flour, 1 L milk ≈ 6 : 6 : 100)
https://www.bbcgoodfoodme.com/recipes/white-sauce (thick: 50 g butter, 50 g flour, 500 ml milk ≈ 9.7 per 100 g)
